description: This file contains the PHP class 'UsersLastImport' which manages the persistence and operations related to the 'users_last_import' table in the SuiteCRM system. It includes methods for deleting, undoing, and retrieving import records associated with users, extending the SugarBean class.

classes.name: UsersLastImport
classes.description: Bean class for handling 'users_last_import' table, including operations for deletion, undo, and retrieval of last import records related to users within SuiteCRM.

methods.name: listviewACLHelper
methods.description: Extends ACL permissions handling for the list view of import records, specifically for the Accounts module.

methods.name: mark_deleted_by_user_id
methods.description: Deletes all import records associated with a specific user ID.

methods.name: undoById
methods.description: Undoes a specific import record by its ID for the current user.

methods.name: undo
methods.description: Undoes all import records for a given module for the current user.

methods.name: _deleteRecord
methods.description: Deletes a specific bean record and its related email addresses.

methods.name: getBeansByImport
methods.description: Retrieves distinct bean types involved in import records for the current user and specified module.
